### Qyşqyldar men negızder himiiasy

Groups: 2 · Skills: 7

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/acidBaseChemistry/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Acid–base chemistry concerns proton transfer, electron-pair interactions, acidity, and the behavior of chemical systems under relevant conditions. Its models, solution properties, transformations and analytical methods are broader than reaction-pattern classification alone.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qyşqyldar men negızderdıñ ärekettesuın jäne qyşqyldyqty ölşeudı zertte.

#### Qyşqyldar men negızder turaly negızgı ūğymdar

Skills: 3

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/acidBaseChemistry/acidBaseFundamentals/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Conceptual acid–base models establish what counts as an acid or base, while strength and pH describe different aspects of chemical behavior and solution conditions.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ärtürlı qyşqyl-negız modelderın, qyşqyldyq pen qyşqyl küşın tüsın.

##### Qyşqyl-negız modelderı

[acidBaseModels.ts](../../../data/skills/acidBaseChemistry/acidBaseFundamentals/acidBaseModels.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish common Arrhenius, Brønsted–Lowry and Lewis descriptions by the chemical interactions each includes.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Keñ tarağan himiialyq modelderdıñ qyşqyl men negızdı qalai anyqtaitynyn salystyr.

##### Qyşqyl küşı

[acidStrength.ts](../../../data/skills/acidBaseChemistry/acidBaseFundamentals/acidStrength.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Describe how strongly an acid tends to donate a proton under specified conditions. A stronger acid transfers protons more readily in a comparable system; this does not mean the solution is necessarily more concentrated or more hazardous.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qyşqyl küşın erıtındınıñ kontsentratsiiasy ne qauıptılıgımen şatastyrma.

##### pH

[pH.ts](../../../data/skills/acidBaseChemistry/acidBaseFundamentals/pH.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret a logarithmic measure of hydrogen-ion activity and its concentration-based approximations.

**User-friendly description (kk):** pH-ty erıtındı qyşqyldyğynyñ logarifmdık ölşemı retınde oqy.

#### Qyşqyl-negız jüielerı

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/acidBaseChemistry/acidBaseSystems/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Neutralization, indicator responses, buffer equilibria and titration exemplify how acid–base behavior is observed, controlled and measured under specific conditions.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qyşqyldar men negızderdıñ qalai ärekettesetının jäne äserı qalai ölşenetının bıl.

##### Qyşqyl-negız indikatorlary

[acidBaseIndicators.ts](../../../data/skills/acidBaseChemistry/acidBaseSystems/acidBaseIndicators.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why some compounds change observable properties as solution acidity varies.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qyşqyldyq özgergende indikatordyñ türı nege özgeretının tüsın.

##### Qyşqyl-negız titrleuı

[acidBaseTitration.ts](../../../data/skills/acidBaseChemistry/acidBaseSystems/acidBaseTitration.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use a measured equivalence relationship to infer an unknown amount or concentration.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Belgısız mölşerdı anyqtau üşın titrleu ölşemderın qoldan.

##### Buferlık erıtındıler

[bufferSolutions.ts](../../../data/skills/acidBaseChemistry/acidBaseSystems/bufferSolutions.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how paired acid–base species resist moderate pH changes.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Bufer qospalary pH özgerısıne qalai qarsy tūratynyn bıl.

##### Beitaraptanu

[neutralization.ts](../../../data/skills/acidBaseChemistry/acidBaseSystems/neutralization.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain net acid–base reactions and avoid assuming every neutralization gives a final pH of seven.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qyşqyl men negız reaktsiiasy nege ärqaşan beitarap pH bermeitının zertte.

### Atomdar jäne periodtylyq

Groups: 5 · Skills: 21

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/atomsAndPeriodicity/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The organization and electronic structure of atoms underpin elemental identity, isotopes, ions and recurring chemical behavior. This domain describes atomic constituents and trends; bond formation is treated separately.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Atomdardyñ ışındegı bölşekterdı jäne himiialyq elementterdı bailanystyratyn periodtyq zañdylyqtardy zertte.

#### Atom qūrylysy

Skills: 4

Skills: 5

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/atomsAndPeriodicity/electronicStructure/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Electron occupancy and energetic organization help explain reactivity and the behavior of valence electrons.

##### Atomdyq orbitaldar

[atomicOrbitals.ts](../../../data/skills/atomsAndPeriodicity/electronicStructure/atomicOrbitals.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret orbitals as probability-based descriptions of electron states and their occupancy rather than fixed electron trajectories.

[electronConfigurations.ts](../../../data/skills/atomsAndPeriodicity/electronicStructure/electronConfigurations.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Represent electron occupation for atoms and ions, respecting the applicable filling rules and exceptions.

[electronShells.ts](../../../data/skills/atomsAndPeriodicity/electronicStructure/electronShells.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use shell organization and principal energy levels to explain patterns of electron distribution without treating shells as literal paths of electrons.

##### İondardyñ tüzıluı

[ionFormation.ts](../../../data/skills/atomsAndPeriodicity/electronicStructure/ionFormation.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Predict plausible monatomic ion charges from electron gain or loss while recognizing chemical context.

##### Valenttık elektrondar

[valenceElectrons.ts](../../../data/skills/atomsAndPeriodicity/electronicStructure/valenceElectrons.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use outer-electron arrangements to reason about common chemical behavior and bonding possibilities.

#### Iadrolyq himiia

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/atomsAndPeriodicity/nuclearChemistry/index.ts)

### Himiialyq bailanystar jäne qūrylym

Groups: 3 · Skills: 12

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/bondingAndStructure/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Chemical properties arise partly from how atoms and ions are connected and how neighboring particles interact. This domain distinguishes intraparticle bonds from interactions between particles and from bulk structural arrangements.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Himiialyq bailanystar men bölşekter arasyndağy tartylys material qasietterın qalai anyqtaitynyn zertte.

#### Himiialyq bailanystar

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/bondingAndStructure/chemicalBonds/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Different electron distributions support different limiting models of chemical bonding; real substances can have mixed characteristics.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Atomdar men iondar elektrondardyñ ärtürlı ornalasuyna qarai himiialyq bailanystardy qalai tüzetının zertte.

[bondPolarity.ts](../../../data/skills/bondingAndStructure/chemicalBonds/bondPolarity.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use electronegativity differences to characterize unequal electron sharing without equating every polar bond with a polar molecule.

[ionicBonding.ts](../../../data/skills/bondingAndStructure/chemicalBonds/ionicBonding.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain electrostatic attraction in extended ionic structures after electron transfer is represented conceptually.

[metallicBonding.ts](../../../data/skills/bondingAndStructure/chemicalBonds/metallicBonding.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate delocalized electrons and ordered metal atoms to common metallic properties.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Metaldardağy qozğalmaly elektrondardy olardyñ tän qasietterımen bailanystyr.

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/bondingAndStructure/interparticleInteractions/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Attractions between distinct particles influence phase behavior, solubility and material properties without changing covalent connectivity.

[hydrogenBonding.ts](../../../data/skills/bondingAndStructure/interparticleInteractions/hydrogenBonding.ts)

### Himiialyq zertteu

Groups: 4 · Skills: 19

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/chemicalInquiry/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Chemical knowledge connects observations of substances with explanations, testable models and reliable evidence. This domain covers chemistry-specific investigation and communication; general research methodology remains a cross-disciplinary concern.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Himikterdıñ zattardy qalai zertteitının, tüsındırmelerdı tekseretının jäne senımdı dälelderdı qoldanatynyn bıl.

Skills: 6

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/chemicalInquiry/analyticalChemistry/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Analytical chemistry identifies particular components in samples and determines their amounts. Sample treatment, chemical selectivity and calibration govern whether signals justify a conclusion; general observation and bulk property comparison are distinct competencies.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Himikterdıñ ülgılerdegı zattardy qalai anyqtap, mölşerın qalai ölşeitının bıl.

[analyticalInterferences.ts](../../../data/skills/chemicalInquiry/analyticalChemistry/analyticalInterferences.ts)

##### Analittı sandyq anyqtau

[quantitativeAnalyteDetermination.ts](../../../data/skills/chemicalInquiry/analyticalChemistry/quantitativeAnalyteDetermination.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Infer the amount or concentration of a specified analyte from a justified measured signal and calculation, accounting for relevant dilution or recovery factors.

[samplePreparationForAnalysis.ts](../../../data/skills/chemicalInquiry/analyticalChemistry/samplePreparationForAnalysis.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Choose sample treatment, such as dissolution, extraction or dilution, to make a specified analyte measurable while considering contamination and analyte loss.

[spectroscopicEvidence.ts](../../../data/skills/chemicalInquiry/analyticalChemistry/spectroscopicEvidence.ts)

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/chemicalInquiry/laboratoryReasoning/index.ts)

[evidenceBasedChemicalConclusions.ts](../../../data/skills/chemicalInquiry/laboratoryReasoning/evidenceBasedChemicalConclusions.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate whether observations justify a claim about composition or reaction, including alternative explanations.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Himiialyq baqylaular ūsynylğan tüsındırmenı şynymen qoldaitynyn bağala.

##### Eksperimenttık ainymalylar

[experimentalVariables.ts](../../../data/skills/chemicalInquiry/laboratoryReasoning/experimentalVariables.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish the manipulated chemical condition, observed response and controlled conditions in an investigation.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ädıl täjıribede qai himiialyq şart özgeretının jäne nenıñ ölşenetının anyqta.

#### Ölşeuler men dälelder

Skills: 5

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/chemicalInquiry/measurementsAndEvidence/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Chemical conclusions depend on measured quantities, recorded conditions and the distinction between observed patterns and explanatory claims.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ölşeuler men mūqiiat baqylaular himiialyq tüsındırmelerdı qalai qoldaitynyn bıl.

##### Himiialyq derekterdı tüsındıru

[chemicalDataInterpretation.ts](../../../data/skills/chemicalInquiry/measurementsAndEvidence/chemicalDataInterpretation.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use tables and graphs to relate changing composition, time, temperature or measured property to chemical behavior.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Himiialyq derekter arqyly jağdailar men nätijeler arasyndağy bailanystardy zertte.

##### Ölşeu belgısızdıgı

[measurementUncertainty.ts](../../../data/skills/chemicalInquiry/measurementsAndEvidence/measurementUncertainty.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret the precision and uncertainty of experimental measurements rather than treating every reported digit as exact.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ölşengen mänder nege absoliut däl emes, belgısızdıkke ie bolatynyn tüsın.

##### Massany ölşeu

[measuringMass.ts](../../../data/skills/chemicalInquiry/measurementsAndEvidence/measuringMass.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine and interpret the mass of a sample, including appropriate units and the effects of container mass.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ydys massasy men ölşem bırlıkterın eskerıp, ülgınıñ massasyn ölşe.

##### Kölemdı ölşeu

[measuringVolume.ts](../../../data/skills/chemicalInquiry/measurementsAndEvidence/measuringVolume.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine liquid or gas volume with suitable measurement conventions and acknowledge instrument limitations.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Sūiyq ne gaz kölemın ölşep, qūraldardyñ şekteulerın tany.

##### Himiialyq qasietterdı baqylau

[observingChemicalProperties.ts](../../../data/skills/chemicalInquiry/measurementsAndEvidence/observingChemicalProperties.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use age-appropriate, adult-led demonstrations or documented observations (for example, iron rusting or a cut apple browning) to identify visible evidence that a material can undergo a chemical change. Have learners describe what changed, distinguish observations from explanations, and connect the evidence to chemical behavior without expecting explanations of reaction mechanisms. Never ask children to taste, smell, heat, or mix unfamiliar substances.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Temırdıñ tot basuy nemese kesılgen almanyñ qoñyrlanuy siiaqty himiialyq özgerıs belgılerın baiqa.

#### Sūraqtar jäne modelder

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/chemicalInquiry/questionsAndModels/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Chemical claims can be examined by specifying substances, observable properties, conditions and possible particle-level explanations.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Himiialyq sūraqtardy dälelder men modelder arqyly qalai qūrastyryp, tüsındıretının üiren.

##### Himiialyq modelder

[chemicalModels.ts](../../../data/skills/chemicalInquiry/questionsAndModels/chemicalModels.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use and critique diagrams, formulas and physical or computational representations according to what they show and omit.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Himiialyq syzbalar men formulalardy paidalanyp, olardyñ şekteulerın tüsın.

##### Himiia ğylym retınde

[chemistryAsADiscipline.ts](../../../data/skills/chemicalInquiry/questionsAndModels/chemistryAsADiscipline.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish questions about composition, properties and transformations of matter from neighboring questions about motion, organisms or technological design.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Himiia zattar men olardyñ özgerısterı turaly qandai sūraqtarğa jauap bere alatynyn bıl.

##### Makroskopiialyq jäne bölşektık tüsındırmeler

[macroscopicAndParticleExplanations.ts](../../../data/skills/chemicalInquiry/questionsAndModels/macroscopicAndParticleExplanations.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate an observable change, such as dissolving or gas formation, to a possible account of particles without confusing the model with direct observation.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Körınetın himiialyq özgerısterdı bölşekter turaly yqtimal tüsındırmelermen bailanystyr.

##### Tekserıletın himiialyq boljamdar

[testableChemicalPredictions.ts](../../../data/skills/chemicalInquiry/questionsAndModels/testableChemicalPredictions.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** State a predicted chemical outcome and the evidence that could support or contradict it.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Himiialyq özgerıs turaly tekserıletın boljam jasa jäne ony qoldaityn dälelderdı anyqta.

Groups: 3 · Skills: 18

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/chemicalLanguageAndQuantities/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Chemists represent composition and transformation with conventional symbols and use amounts to connect microscopic entities to measurable samples. This domain covers representational and quantitative relationships, not specific reaction mechanisms.

**Methodological description (English):** Connect formula composition to mass per mole using atomic masses.

##### Reaktsiia şyğymy

[reactionYield.ts](../../../data/skills/chemicalLanguageAndQuantities/amountOfSubstance/reactionYield.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish theoretical yield, observed yield and percentage yield without attributing every shortfall to one cause.

[stoichiometricRatios.ts](../../../data/skills/chemicalLanguageAndQuantities/amountOfSubstance/stoichiometricRatios.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use balanced coefficients to relate amounts of reactants and products.

##### Mol

[theMole.ts](../../../data/skills/chemicalLanguageAndQuantities/amountOfSubstance/theMole.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret amount of substance as a count-based quantity defined through Avogadro's constant.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Moldı himiialyq bölşekterdıñ belgılengen sany dep tüsın.

Skills: 8

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/chemicalLanguageAndQuantities/chemicalNotation/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Symbols and formulas must preserve elemental identity, proportions and charge while being read according to their convention.

[elementSymbols.ts](../../../data/skills/chemicalLanguageAndQuantities/chemicalNotation/elementSymbols.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Derive or interpret the simplest whole-number elemental ratio without assuming that it specifies one molecule.

**Methodological description (English):** Apply systematic naming conventions to inorganic compounds, considering ionic or covalent composition and oxidation states where relevant.

[organicNomenclature.ts](../../../data/skills/chemicalLanguageAndQuantities/chemicalNotation/organicNomenclature.ts)

### Himiialyq reaktsiialar

Groups: 3 · Skills: 13

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/chemicalReactions/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** This domain identifies and explains transformations in which constituent atoms are rearranged or electron/proton transfer occurs. Chemical equation notation and amount calculations remain in their dedicated domain.

Skills: 5

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/chemicalReactions/oxidationAndReduction/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how externally supplied electrical energy drives non-spontaneous redox reactions at electrodes, including transformations such as electroplating.

##### Galvanikalyq elementter

[galvanicCells.ts](../../../data/skills/chemicalReactions/oxidationAndReduction/galvanicCells.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how spontaneous, spatially separated oxidation and reduction reactions deliver electrical work through an external circuit while charge also flows through the electrolyte.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Bölek jüretın redoks reaktsiialar elementte elektr quatyn qalai şyğaratynyn bıl.

##### Totyğu

[oxidation.ts](../../../data/skills/chemicalReactions/oxidationAndReduction/oxidation.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify increases in formal oxidation state or electron loss in appropriate reaction descriptions.

[redoxCouples.ts](../../../data/skills/chemicalReactions/oxidationAndReduction/redoxCouples.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate oxidation of one participant to reduction of another and identify oxidizing or reducing agents.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Bır zat totyğyp jatqanda ekınşısı qalai totyqsyzdanatynyn tüsındır.

##### Totyqsyzdanu

[reduction.ts](../../../data/skills/chemicalReactions/oxidationAndReduction/reduction.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify decreases in formal oxidation state or electron gain in appropriate reaction descriptions.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Elektron qosyp alu ne totyğu därejesınıñ kemuı arqyly totyqsyzdanudy anyqta.

#### Reaktsiia türlerı

Skills: 6

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/chemicalReactions/reactionPatterns/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Reaction patterns classify transformations such as combination, decomposition, precipitation, displacement, combustion and hydrolysis. Some categories may overlap and do not by themselves determine a detailed reaction mechanism.

##### Janu

[combustion.ts](../../../data/skills/chemicalReactions/reactionPatterns/combustion.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Characterize reactions with an oxidant that release energy, distinguishing combustion from mere heating.

##### Ydyrau reaktsiialary

[decompositionReactions.ts](../../../data/skills/chemicalReactions/reactionPatterns/decompositionReactions.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize processes in which one chemical species gives rise to multiple products.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Bır himiialyq zat bırneşe önımge ydyraityn jağdaidy tany.

##### Orynbasu reaktsiialary

[displacementReactions.ts](../../../data/skills/chemicalReactions/reactionPatterns/displacementReactions.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Reason about when one element can replace another in a compound.

##### Gidroliz

[hydrolysis.ts](../../../data/skills/chemicalReactions/reactionPatterns/hydrolysis.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize reactions in which water participates in bond cleavage or chemical conversion.

##### Tūnba tüzılu reaktsiialary

[precipitationReactions.ts](../../../data/skills/chemicalReactions/reactionPatterns/precipitationReactions.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the formation of an insoluble product from reacting dissolved species.

##### Qosylu reaktsiialary

[synthesisReactions.ts](../../../data/skills/chemicalReactions/reactionPatterns/synthesisReactions.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize processes producing a new compound from simpler starting substances.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qarapaiym zattar bırıgıp jaña qosylys tüzetın jağdaidy tany.

#### Reaktsiialardy tanu

Skills: 2

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/chemicalReactions/recognizingReactions/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognizing chemical change requires identifying initial and resulting chemical species and examining observations critically rather than treating any visible sign as proof.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Baqylau reaktsiianyñ ötkenın qalai däleldei alatynyn üiren.

##### Reagentter men önımder

[reactantsAndProducts.ts](../../../data/skills/chemicalReactions/recognizingReactions/reactantsAndProducts.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify starting and resulting chemical species while distinguishing them from catalysts and solvents.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Bastapqy reagentter men önımderdı katalizatorlar men erıtkışterden ajyrat.

##### Reaktsiia belgılerı

[reactionEvidence.ts](../../../data/skills/chemicalReactions/recognizingReactions/reactionEvidence.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret gas evolution, precipitates, color changes or thermal effects as possible evidence, with appropriate alternative explanations.

### Bızdı qorşağan himiia

Groups: 4 · Skills: 20

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/chemistryInTheWorld/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Chemical concepts support understanding of manufactured materials, environmental systems and molecules associated with life. The emphasis is composition, transformation and evidence—not industrial process engineering, clinical advice or organism-level biology.

Skills: 5

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/chemistryInTheWorld/airAndWater/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Environmental samples contain reacting or partitioning chemical species whose measurements require attention to concentration and chemical form.

[atmosphericChemicalChanges.ts](../../../data/skills/chemistryInTheWorld/airAndWater/atmosphericChemicalChanges.ts)

[carbonChemistryInTheEnvironment.ts](../../../data/skills/chemistryInTheWorld/airAndWater/carbonChemistryInTheEnvironment.ts)

##### Auanyñ qūramy

[compositionOfAir.ts](../../../data/skills/chemistryInTheWorld/airAndWater/compositionOfAir.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish major atmospheric components from variable traces and pollutants.

##### Su erıtkış retınde

[waterAsASolvent.ts](../../../data/skills/chemistryInTheWorld/airAndWater/waterAsASolvent.ts)

##### Sudyñ lastağyştary

[waterContaminants.ts](../../../data/skills/chemistryInTheWorld/airAndWater/waterContaminants.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Classify dissolved and particulate contaminants by chemical identity and behavior without assuming visible clarity proves safety.

#### Materialdar himiiasy

Skills: 7

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/chemistryInTheWorld/materialsChemistry/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A product's useful behavior depends on composition, microscopic structure and conditions of use, not merely its everyday material label.

##### Korroziia

[corrosion.ts](../../../data/skills/chemistryInTheWorld/materialsChemistry/corrosion.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain electrochemical deterioration and the chemical basis of common protective principles.

[elastomers.ts](../../../data/skills/chemistryInTheWorld/materialsChemistry/elastomers.ts)

##### Metaldardy qoldanu

[metalsInUse.ts](../../../data/skills/chemistryInTheWorld/materialsChemistry/metalsInUse.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate elemental metallic structure and processing to characteristic conductivity, deformation and corrosion.

##### Plastmassalar

[plastics.ts](../../../data/skills/chemistryInTheWorld/materialsChemistry/plastics.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate polymer chemistry and processing to the shaping, durability and temperature-dependent behavior of plastic materials.

#### Tırşılık molekulalary

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/chemistryInTheWorld/moleculesOfLife/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Chemical structure explains molecular behavior that biology may later place in cellular or organismal context.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Mañyzdy biologiialyq zattardyñ molekulalyq qūrylysyn zertte.

##### Kömırsular himiiasy

[carbohydrateChemistry.ts](../../../data/skills/chemistryInTheWorld/moleculesOfLife/carbohydrateChemistry.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate sugar units, glycosidic connections and chemical properties in small and polymeric carbohydrates.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qant bırlıkterı qosylyp, türlı kömırsulardy qalai tüzetının bıl.

##### Lipidter himiiasy

[lipidChemistry.ts](../../../data/skills/chemistryInTheWorld/moleculesOfLife/lipidChemistry.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize characteristic structures and intermolecular behavior of fats, oils and other lipid families.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Mailar, sūiyq mailar jäne basqa lipidterdıñ qūrylysy men himiialyq qasietterın salystyr.

##### Nuklein qyşqyldarynyñ himiiasy

[nucleicAcidChemistry.ts](../../../data/skills/chemistryInTheWorld/moleculesOfLife/nucleicAcidChemistry.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify nucleotide components and the covalent framework of nucleic acids without teaching genetic inheritance as the primary competency.

**User-friendly description (kk):** DNQ men RNQ-nyñ himiialyq qūrambölıkterı men qañqasyn tüsın.

##### Näruyzdar himiiasy

[proteinChemistry.ts](../../../data/skills/chemistryInTheWorld/moleculesOfLife/proteinChemistry.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate amino-acid connectivity and chemical interactions to protein structure.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Aminqyşqyldar men olardyñ ärekettesulerı näruyzdyñ qūrylymyn qalai qalyptastyratynyn bıl.

#### Himiiadağy tūraqty tañdau

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/chemistryInTheWorld/sustainableChemicalChoices/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Environmental and resource decisions benefit from chemical evidence about composition, persistence, transformations and alternatives.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Materialdar, qaldyqtar men resurstar jönındegı şeşımder üşın himiialyq dälelderdı qoldan.

##### Biologiialyq ydyrau jäne tūraqtylyq

[biodegradationAndPersistence.ts](../../../data/skills/chemistryInTheWorld/sustainableChemicalChoices/biodegradationAndPersistence.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish chemically or biologically degradable compounds from persistent materials under actual environmental conditions.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Zattar qorşağan ortada qaşan ydyrap, qaşan ūzaq saqtalatynyn tüsın.

##### Himiialyq zattardyñ ömırlık tsiklderı

[chemicalLifeCycles.ts](../../../data/skills/chemistryInTheWorld/sustainableChemicalChoices/chemicalLifeCycles.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Trace a substance through sourcing, use, chemical change and waste streams rather than evaluating one stage in isolation.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Zattyñ öndırısten paidalanu men qaldyqqa deiıngı jolyn bır kezeñmen şektelmei qadağala.

##### Jasyl himiia qağidalary

[greenChemistryPrinciples.ts](../../../data/skills/chemistryInTheWorld/sustainableChemicalChoices/greenChemistryPrinciples.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate a proposed chemical process by waste prevention, safer inputs, energy demand and material efficiency without assuming any process has zero impact.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Himiialyq protsesterdı qaldyq, qauıpsızdık, energiia jäne material tiımdılıgı boiynşa salystyr.

##### Qaita öñdeu himiiasy

[recyclingChemistry.ts](../../../data/skills/chemistryInTheWorld/sustainableChemicalChoices/recyclingChemistry.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain when chemical composition enables or limits separation, reprocessing and material recovery.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Materialdyñ qūramy qaita öñdeu men qalpyna keltıruge qalai äser etetının zertte.

### Energiia, jyldamdyq jäne tepe-teñdık

Groups: 3 · Skills: 19

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/energyRatesAndEquilibrium/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Chemical systems exchange energy, evolve at finite rates and may approach dynamic equilibrium. These are related but distinct questions: whether change is favorable, how quickly it occurs and what composition persists.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Energiia özgerısın, reaktsiia jyldamdyğyn, tura jäne kerı reaktsiialar tepe-teñdıgın zertte.

#### Himiialyq energetika

Skills: 8

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/energyRatesAndEquilibrium/chemicalEnergetics/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Energy changes are properties of a system and its processes, not intrinsic fuel labels or a claim that breaking bonds alone releases energy.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Himiialyq özgerısterde energiianyñ qalai jūtylyp, bölınıp ne qaita taralatynyn bıl.

##### Bailanys energiiasyn bağalau

[bondEnergyEstimates.ts](../../../data/skills/energyRatesAndEquilibrium/chemicalEnergetics/bondEnergyEstimates.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Approximate enthalpy changes from bonds broken and formed while recognizing average bond-energy limitations.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Üzılgen jäne tüzılgen bailanystardan reaktsiia energiiasyn boljap, model şegın esker.

##### Kalorimetriia

[calorimetry.ts](../../../data/skills/energyRatesAndEquilibrium/chemicalEnergetics/calorimetry.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Infer heat transfer from measured temperature change, heat capacity and appropriate system boundaries, recognizing energy losses and measurement uncertainty.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jylu şyğynyn eskerıp, temperatura özgerısınen jylu almasudy bağala.

##### Endotermiialyq protsester

[endothermicProcesses.ts](../../../data/skills/energyRatesAndEquilibrium/chemicalEnergetics/endothermicProcesses.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret positive system enthalpy change and recognize that absorbing heat need not mean a reaction cannot occur.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jylu jūtatyn protsestı tany, bıraq ol jürmeidı dep oilama.

##### Entropiia

[entropy.ts](../../../data/skills/energyRatesAndEquilibrium/chemicalEnergetics/entropy.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate the multiplicity of microscopic arrangements and energy dispersal to changes in thermodynamic entropy.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Energiianyñ taraluy men bölşek ornalasuynyñ entropiiamen bailanysyn zertte.

##### Ekzotermiialyq protsester

[exothermicProcesses.ts](../../../data/skills/energyRatesAndEquilibrium/chemicalEnergetics/exothermicProcesses.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret negative system enthalpy change under stated conditions and distinguish released heat from reaction rate.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jylu böletın protsestı tany, bıraq ony mındettı türde jyldam dep oilama.

##### Gibbs energiiasy

[gibbsEnergy.ts](../../../data/skills/energyRatesAndEquilibrium/chemicalEnergetics/gibbsEnergy.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate enthalpy, temperature and entropy to the direction of spontaneous change at constant temperature and pressure.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Belgılı jağdaida himiialyq özgerıs tiımdı me, Gibbs energiiasymen bağala.

##### Gess zañy

[hesssLaw.ts](../../../data/skills/energyRatesAndEquilibrium/chemicalEnergetics/hesssLaw.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Combine known reaction equations and associated enthalpy changes to determine an overall enthalpy change using the state-function character of enthalpy.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Belgılı reaktsiialardyñ energiia özgerısın bırıktırıp, basqa reaktsiia entalpiiasyn esepte.

##### Reaktsiia entalpiiasy

[reactionEnthalpy.ts](../../../data/skills/energyRatesAndEquilibrium/chemicalEnergetics/reactionEnthalpy.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate heat at constant pressure to the difference in enthalpy between states.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Entalpiia özgerısı boiynşa reaktsiiağa deiıngı jäne keiıngı energiiany salystyr.

#### Himiialyq tepe-teñdık

Skills: 5

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/energyRatesAndEquilibrium/chemicalEquilibrium/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Forward and reverse processes may continue while bulk composition becomes steady; equilibrium responds to conditions.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tura jäne kerı reaktsiialar tepe-teñdıkke jetkende ne bolatynyn zertte.

##### Dinamikalyq tepe-teñdık

[dynamicEquilibrium.ts](../../../data/skills/energyRatesAndEquilibrium/chemicalEquilibrium/dynamicEquilibrium.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish equal forward and reverse rates from absence of reaction.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tepe-teñdık kontsentratsiialary tūraqty bolsa da reaktsiialar nege jalğasatynyn tüsın.

##### Tepe-teñdık tūraqtylary

[equilibriumConstants.ts](../../../data/skills/energyRatesAndEquilibrium/chemicalEquilibrium/equilibriumConstants.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret an equilibrium expression as relating activities or their appropriate approximations at a given temperature.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tepe-teñdık tūraqtysyn ärekettesetın zattardyñ qatynasy retınde tüsındır.

##### Tepe-teñdıktıñ yğysuy

[equilibriumShifts.ts](../../../data/skills/energyRatesAndEquilibrium/chemicalEquilibrium/equilibriumShifts.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Reason about changes in equilibrium composition after concentration, pressure or temperature disturbances.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Şarttar özgerse, tepe-teñdık qūramy qalai auysatynyn bolja.

##### Reaktsiianyñ qaitymdylyğy

[reactionReversibility.ts](../../../data/skills/energyRatesAndEquilibrium/chemicalEquilibrium/reactionReversibility.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine when products can reform reactants, distinguishing a possible reverse pathway from a system that has actually reached dynamic equilibrium.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ekı bağytta da jüre alatyn reaktsiialardy tany.

##### Erıgıştık tepe-teñdıgı

[solubilityEquilibrium.ts](../../../data/skills/energyRatesAndEquilibrium/chemicalEquilibrium/solubilityEquilibrium.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret precipitation and dissolution in terms of competing ionic concentrations and an equilibrium threshold.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Erıgen iondar men qatty zat arasyndağy eru jäne tūnba tüzılu tepe-teñdıgın zertte.

#### Reaktsiia jyldamdyqtary

Skills: 6

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/energyRatesAndEquilibrium/reactionRates/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Rates describe how fast concentrations or amounts change, which can vary independently of a reaction's net energy change.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Reagentter önımderge qanşalyqty tez ainalatynyn zertte.

##### Kataliz

[catalysis.ts](../../../data/skills/energyRatesAndEquilibrium/reactionRates/catalysis.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain alternate reaction pathways and activation barriers without treating a catalyst as a stoichiometric reactant consumed overall.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Katalizatorlar jalpy jūmsalmai, reaktsiialardy qalai jyldamdatatynyn bıl.

##### Kontsentratsiia äserı

[concentrationEffects.ts](../../../data/skills/energyRatesAndEquilibrium/reactionRates/concentrationEffects.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how changing reactant concentration can influence encounter frequency and rate.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Reagentterdıñ kontsentratsiiasy özgerse, reaktsiia jyldamdyğy nege özgeretının tüsındır.

##### Jyldamdyq zañdary

[rateLaws.ts](../../../data/skills/energyRatesAndEquilibrium/reactionRates/rateLaws.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate reaction rate to reactant concentrations using an experimentally determined rate expression rather than assuming exponents from equation coefficients.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Kontsentratsiia men reaktsiia jyldamdyğynyñ täjıribelık bailanysyn qoldan.

##### Reaktsiia retı

[reactionOrder.ts](../../../data/skills/energyRatesAndEquilibrium/reactionRates/reactionOrder.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify individual and overall concentration exponents of an empirical rate law and use them to predict rate changes when concentrations vary.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Reaktsiia retı jyldamdyq özgerısıne qalai äser etetının anyqta.

##### Reaktsiia jyldamdyğy

[reactionRate.ts](../../../data/skills/energyRatesAndEquilibrium/reactionRates/reactionRate.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret change in reactant or product amount over time with consistent sign and units.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Uaqyt ötkende reagentter azaiuy nemese önımder tüzıluı qanşalyqty tez ekenın esepte.

##### Temperatura äserı

[temperatureEffects.ts](../../../data/skills/energyRatesAndEquilibrium/reactionRates/temperatureEffects.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Connect temperature to the distribution of molecular energies and reaction rates.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Temperatura bölşekterdıñ nätijelı ärekettesu yqtimaldyğyna qalai äser etetının tüsın.

### Beiorganikalyq himiia

Groups: 3 · Skills: 13

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/inorganicChemistry/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The chemistry of elements and non-carbon-centered substance families provides a systematic account of familiar materials and dissolved ions. Organic chemistry handles carbon-based families in greater detail.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Elementterdıñ, beiorganikalyq qosylystardyñ jäne erıgen iondardyñ qasietterı men äreketın zertte.

#### Elementter otbasylary

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/inorganicChemistry/elementFamiliesInContext/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Elemental forms can vary in structure, oxidation state and behavior despite shared periodic classification.

[allotropes.ts](../../../data/skills/inorganicChemistry/elementFamiliesInContext/allotropes.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize distinct structural forms of one element, such as graphite and diamond, and their different properties.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Bır element atomdarynyñ ärtürlı ornalasuy arqyly qalai türlı zat tüzetının bıl.

##### Metaldardyñ himiialyq belsendılıgı

[metalReactivity.ts](../../../data/skills/inorganicChemistry/elementFamiliesInContext/metalReactivity.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare how different metals undergo oxidation, form ions and participate in displacement reactions under relevant conditions, distinct from the detailed mechanisms of corrosion.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ūqsas jağdaida ärtürlı metaldar nelıkten ärqalai ärekettesetının tüsındır.

##### Asyl gazdar

[nobleGases.ts](../../../data/skills/inorganicChemistry/elementFamiliesInContext/nobleGases.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain low typical reactivity from electron structure while recognizing that compounds of some noble gases exist.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Asyl gazdardyñ ädette belsendılıgı tömen bolğanymen, keibırı bailanys tüze alatynyn tüsın.

##### Beimetaldar

[nonmetals.ts](../../../data/skills/inorganicChemistry/elementFamiliesInContext/nonmetals.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate elemental forms such as oxygen, nitrogen, sulfur and halogens to characteristic chemical behavior.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ottek, azot, kükırt jäne basqa beimetaldardyñ himiialyq qasietterın zertte.

#### Beiorganikalyq qosylystar

Skills: 5

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/inorganicChemistry/inorganicCompounds/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Inorganic formulas and classes describe varied substances whose behavior is not determined by a class name alone.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Beiorganikalyq qosylystardyñ negızgı toptaryn tany, bıraq olardyñ bärı bırdei äreket etedı dep oilama.

##### Koordinatsiialyq qosylystar

[coordinationCompounds.ts](../../../data/skills/inorganicChemistry/inorganicCompounds/coordinationCompounds.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret a central metal species surrounded by ligands as a structure distinct from a simple ionic formula.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Koordinatsiialyq qosylysta ligandtar ortalyq metall atomyn ne ionyn qalai qorşaitynyn tüsın.

##### Gidroksidter

[hydroxides.ts](../../../data/skills/inorganicChemistry/inorganicCompounds/hydroxides.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret hydroxide-containing substances and their dissociation or reactivity in context.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Gidroksid qosylystaryn jäne olardyñ himiialyq reaktsiialardağy äreketın tany.

##### Mineraldar

[minerals.ts](../../../data/skills/inorganicChemistry/inorganicCompounds/minerals.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how naturally occurring crystalline substances are classified by chemistry and structure.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Mineraldardyñ himiialyq qūramy men kristaldyq qūrylysyn jıkteluımen bailanystyr.

##### Oksidter

[oxides.ts](../../../data/skills/inorganicChemistry/inorganicCompounds/oxides.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish oxide composition and broad acidic, basic or amphoteric chemical behavior.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Oksidterdıñ ärtürlı türlerı men himiialyq qasietterın zertte.

##### Tūzdar

[salts.ts](../../../data/skills/inorganicChemistry/inorganicCompounds/salts.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize ionic compounds and their compositional relationship to cations and anions.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tūzdardy oñ jäne terıs zariadtalğan iondardan qūralğan qosylystar retınde tany.

#### Sudağy iondar

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/inorganicChemistry/ionsInWater/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Water permits dissociation and characteristic aqueous reactions, but not every dissolved substance produces free ions.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Zattardyñ suda erıgen kezdegı qasietterın zertte.

##### Elektrolitter

[electrolytes.ts](../../../data/skills/inorganicChemistry/ionsInWater/electrolytes.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish strong, weak and nonelectrolyte behavior in solution.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Erıtındıdegı äreketı boiynşa küştı, älsız elektrolitter men beielektrolitterdı ajyrat.

##### İondyq teñdeuler

[ionicEquations.ts](../../../data/skills/inorganicChemistry/ionsInWater/ionicEquations.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Represent only the species participating in a net aqueous chemical change.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Suly erıtındıdegı reaktsiiağa naqty qai iondar qatysatynyn körsetetın teñdeulerdı jaz.

##### Erıgıştık erejelerı

[solubilityRules.ts](../../../data/skills/inorganicChemistry/ionsInWater/solubilityRules.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use empirical patterns to anticipate precipitation while checking exceptions and conditions.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Erıgıştık zañdylyqtarymen tūnba tüzıluın bolja, bıraq erekşelıkterdı de tekser.

##### Sudyñ kermektıgı

[waterHardness.ts](../../../data/skills/inorganicChemistry/ionsInWater/waterHardness.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate dissolved calcium and magnesium species to characteristic reactions and practical effects.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Erıgen kaltsii men magnii sudyñ kermektıgıne qalai äser etetının tüsındır.

### Qospalar jäne erıtındıler

Groups: 4 · Skills: 22

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/mixturesAndSolutions/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Components of mixtures retain their chemical identities while distribution, solubility and relative amounts determine useful properties. Separation methods exploit differences in physical behavior rather than requiring reaction.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Zattar qalai aralasatynyn, eritının jäne qaita bölınetının zertte.

#### Kontsentratsiia

Skills: 5

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/mixturesAndSolutions/concentration/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A solution's composition can be represented in several quantitatively distinct ways, each with an appropriate denominator.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Erıtındıdegı zat mölşerın sipattaudyñ türlı täsılderın bıl.

[colligativeProperties.ts](../../../data/skills/mixturesAndSolutions/concentration/colligativeProperties.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate changes such as freezing-point depression to dissolved particle concentration under appropriate assumptions.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Erıgen bölşekterdıñ qatu men qainauğa nege äser etetının zertte.

##### Kontsentratsiialardy salystyru

[concentrationComparisons.ts](../../../data/skills/mixturesAndSolutions/concentration/concentrationComparisons.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare dilute and concentrated samples without confusing concentration with solubility or toxicity.

##### Sūiyltu

[dilution.ts](../../../data/skills/mixturesAndSolutions/concentration/dilution.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use conservation of solute amount to relate concentrations and volumes before and after adding solvent.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Erıgen zat mölşerı özgermei, erıtkış qosylğanda kontsentratsiianyñ qalai özgeretının esepte.

[massFraction.ts](../../../data/skills/mixturesAndSolutions/concentration/massFraction.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate solute mass to total solution mass rather than to solvent mass.

[molarConcentration.ts](../../../data/skills/mixturesAndSolutions/concentration/molarConcentration.ts)

#### Eru jäne erıgıştık

Skills: 6

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/mixturesAndSolutions/dissolutionAndSolubility/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Dissolution reflects competing interactions and may depend strongly on substance and conditions.

[dissolving.ts](../../../data/skills/mixturesAndSolutions/dissolutionAndSolubility/dissolving.ts)

##### Gazdardyñ erıgıştıgı jäne qysym

[gasSolubilityAndPressure.ts](../../../data/skills/mixturesAndSolutions/dissolutionAndSolubility/gasSolubilityAndPressure.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate gas dissolution to partial pressure and equilibrium under relevant conditions.

[saturation.ts](../../../data/skills/mixturesAndSolutions/dissolutionAndSolubility/saturation.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish unsaturated, saturated and supersaturated states and their practical stability.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qanyqpağan, qanyqqan jäne asa qanyqqan erıtındılerdı ajyrat.

##### Erıgıştık

[solubility.ts](../../../data/skills/mixturesAndSolutions/dissolutionAndSolubility/solubility.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret the maximum equilibrium amount of solute under specified conditions.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Belgılı jağdaida eri alatyn zat mölşerın erıgıştık qalai şekteitının tüsın.

##### Erıtkış pen erıgen zattyñ üilesımdılıgı

[solventSoluteCompatibility.ts](../../../data/skills/mixturesAndSolutions/dissolutionAndSolubility/solventSoluteCompatibility.ts)

##### Temperatura jäne erıgıştık

[temperatureAndSolubility.ts](../../../data/skills/mixturesAndSolutions/dissolutionAndSolubility/temperatureAndSolubility.ts)

#### Qospalar jüielerı

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/mixturesAndSolutions/mixtureSystems/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Mixtures may contain more than one phase or dispersed material with properties depending on particle size and composition.

##### Qorytpalar

[alloys.ts](../../../data/skills/mixturesAndSolutions/mixtureSystems/alloys.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret metallic mixtures or solid solutions without assuming every alloy has a fixed compound formula.

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish matter containing one element from substances whose constituent elements occur in fixed chemical proportions.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Himiialyq elementterdı ärtürlı elementterden tūratyn qosylystardan ajyrat.

##### Bırtektı jäne ärtektı ülgıler

[homogeneousAndHeterogeneousSamples.ts](../../../data/skills/substancesAndProperties/composition/homogeneousAndHeterogeneousSamples.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Classify samples by whether their composition and phases are uniform at the relevant scale.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ülgınıñ bırkelkı ekenın nemese türlı bölıkterı men fazalary baryn anyqta.

##### Qospalar

[mixtures.ts](../../../data/skills/substancesAndProperties/composition/mixtures.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize combinations whose component proportions can vary without making a new substance.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qūramdas bölıkterınıñ araqatynasy özgeruı mümkın qospalardy tany.

##### Taza zattar

[pureSubstances.ts](../../../data/skills/substancesAndProperties/composition/pureSubstances.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish a chemically defined substance from a sample containing additional components, even when the sample appears uniform.
